Article Title: Government planning to bring E10 back? Clamour grows after top bureaucrat's remark
Article Text:
E20 is petrol containing 20% ethanol and 80% petrol. (Generative image)

Why E20 has become controversial

The bigger policy question

NEW DELHI: The debate over E20 petrol has taken a fresh turn after chief economic adviser (CEA) V Anantha Nageswaran argued that lower-ethanol fuel such as E10 should be made available for older vehicles, even as government officials maintain that there is currently no plan to bring E10 back to fuel stations.Nageswaran's position has added weight to demands from vehicle owners and political leaders who have been seeking a lower-ethanol option since E20 became the only petrol variant available at fuel pumps from April 2026.In an opinion piece, Nageswaran and department of economic affairs consultant Akash Poojari argued that older vehicles need protection while the industry works on making them compatible with higher ethanol blends.The article acknowledged that there is no strong evidence of widespread engine damage from E20, but pointed to a specific concern involving older vehicles. India has an estimated 75 to 80 million older two-wheelers, some of which have rubber seals that were not designed to handle higher ethanol content."India has roughly 75 to 80 million older two-wheelers ... older rubber ⁠seals that are not rated for ethanol are a separate problem ...retrofitting those seals... that way will take years," the opinion piece said.The authors said the government should "protect the existing fleet while the retrofit programme catches up,".The argument has effectively revived the question of whether motorists with older vehicles should have the option of buying E10, which contains 10% ethanol, alongside E20, which contains 20% ethanol.Despite the CEA's suggestion, officials dealing with the ethanol policy said there is currently no discussion within the government to reintroduce E10 at fuel stations.Officials said bringing back a separate lower-blend petrol would require additional infrastructure and could create complications over pricing, storage and distribution. They also pointed to the large ecosystem that has developed around the government's 20% ethanol blending programme.One official said the government had already stated last month that there was no proposal to bring back lower-ethanol variants such as E0 or E10.Another official argued that offering E10 could be interpreted as an admission that E20 is unsuitable for older vehicles, something the government does not accept."Also, allowing the sale of E10 would mean govt is accepting E20 petrol is not good for older vehicles which is not the case. Studies have shown E20 does not cause any mechanical issues," said another official.This means that, despite the CEA's call for a lower-blend option, there is no government decision at present to make E10 available again.E20 is petrol containing 20% ethanol and 80% petrol. The government has promoted higher ethanol blending as a way to reduce crude oil imports, save foreign exchange and improve India's energy security. India also achieved its 20% blending target ahead of the original 2030 deadline.However, the nationwide shift has generated concerns among some vehicle owners, particularly those with older vehicles. The most common complaint has been lower fuel efficiency, while some motorists have also raised concerns about fuel lines, seals and other components.The issue gained further attention after senior executives from major automobile companies privately raised concerns about contamination in E20 fuel. The concerns were subsequently followed by a wider public debate over the compatibility of older vehicles with the fuel.At the same time, the government and automobile industry have maintained that available testing does not show widespread mechanical damage from E20. Automakers have also said that older vehicles can operate on E20, although fuel efficiency can be affected.The latest debate has also given the opposition fresh ammunition, with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav on Wednesday questioning the government's position on E20 after reports of Nageswaran's recommendation emerged.In a post on X, Yadav shared a picture citing the CEA's reported remarks and asked, "Who is right: the government or the adviser?""E20 petrol is damaging vehicles. The sale of E10 petrol should start again for old two-wheelers," read the picture shared by Yadav.Yadav said motorists who believe their vehicles have developed problems after using E20 are being left to seek help, while the government continues to maintain that there is no issue with the fuel.He also questioned why the government was not directly seeking feedback from vehicle owners who have reported problems.Calling E20 a "double-edged sword", Yadav said it was creating a "double burden" for consumers through petrol costs and higher vehicle maintenance expenses.Earlier, Lok Sabha leader of opposition Rahul Gandhi said Congress will soon take up the issue of the Centre's E20 ethanol-blended fuel programme.In a social media post on X, Rahul shared a video and accused the government of "stealing directly out of people's pockets"."This E20 issue is a very serious matter. Usually, we say, 'Daal mein kuch kaala hai.' But here, the whole daal is black," the Congress leader said."Brothers and sisters, this is a matter of priorities. In any campaign, we have to decide the order in which issues are taken up. The problem right now is that there is so much corruption that there is a long list of issues we have to prioritise. But don't worry. We will take up the E20 issue in a big way because it is damaging people's cars and scooters and their lives and is, quite literally, stealing money directly out of their pockets," he added.The immediate question is not whether the government has decided to bring E10 back. It has not. The issue is whether it will eventually consider giving owners of older vehicles a choice between different ethanol blends.The CEA's intervention has brought that question back into focus at a time when E20 is already the standard petrol available across the country. The government, however, continues to defend the broader ethanol programme on the grounds of lower crude oil dependence, reduced emissions and greater energy security.For now, the positions remain different. Nageswaran's opinion has called for protection of the existing older vehicle fleet, while officials say reintroducing E10 would be difficult and is not under consideration at present.
Article Summary: Chief economic adviser (cea) v anantha nageswaran argued that lower-ethanol fuel such as e10 should be made available for older vehicles. India has an estimated 75 to 80 million older two-wheelers, some of which have rubber seals that were not designed to handle higher ethanol content.

Article Title: FSSAI action prompts Amway, Emami, four other brands to drop '100%' product claims
Article Text:
FSSAI has recently taken action against companies operating in several segments.

NEW DELHI: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has stepped up action against food companies using "100%" claims on product labels and in advertisements, saying several firms have now removed such claims following regulatory intervention.The food regulator said on Wednesday that six food business operators had taken corrective steps after being asked to discontinue the use of "100%" on labels, packaging, promotional material and advertisements.Among the companies that changed their labelling were Amway India, Emami, Bonn Biscuits, Apis India, Juza Foods and Masterchow Foods.FSSAI said Bonn Biscuits had used a "100%" claim in an advertisement for its Bonn Cummin Flavor Jeera Bite Biscuits, 76 gm. The company has since removed the claim from its website.Emami was also asked to address its use of a 100 per cent claim for Zhandu Honey. According to FSSAI, the company complied with its advisory and took corrective action.Apis India has removed similar claims from its honey products, the regulator said.Amway India Enterprises had been using the claim "100% Pure Coconut Oil" for one of its products. Following FSSAI's intervention, the company submitted a compliance response confirming that it had voluntarily removed "100%" from its packaging and promotional material.The company also told the regulator that older stock carrying the claim had been discontinued from sales channels.Kerala-based Juza Foods has removed 100 per cent claims from several of its baby food products, while Masterchow Foods has taken down a similar claim from its Ramen Noodle product.The action is part of a wider FSSAI drive against what it considers misleading claims in food labelling and advertising. The regulator has been asking food business operators to stop using the term "100%" where it could create a misleading impression about a product.FSSAI has also taken enforcement action against several other food businesses in recent months, including companies in the energy drink and alcoholic beverage sectors.The regulator said on Tuesday that six companies, including Dabur India and Ferns N Petals, had corrected issues identified in notices concerning misleading labels, claims and advertisements.Earlier on Sunday, FSSAI said another six food companies had taken corrective measures, including withdrawing misleading labels and trademarks, after receiving notices for alleged violations of food safety laws.
Article Summary: Fssai has recently taken action against companies operating in several segments. Amway india, emami, bonn biscuits, apis india, juza foods and masterchow foods among those that changed their labelling. The action is part of a wider fssai drive against what it considers misleading claims.

Article Title: CCPA fines Amazon Rs 1 lakh for misleading ‘Shri Ram Mandir Ayodhya Prasad’ listings
Article Text:
CCPA fined Amazon Rs 1 lakh for allowing misleading ads selling ordinary sweets as 'Shri Ram Mandir Ayodhya Prasad'

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) has imposed a Rs 1 lakh penalty on e-commerce major Amazon for allowing misleading advertisements and listings of sweets falsely marketed as “Shri Ram Mandir Ayodhya Prasad” on its platform. It found there was no authorisation from Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust for the laddu (sweets) sold as prasad.In its order, CCPA observed that the phrase “Shri Ram Mandir Ayodhya Prasad” carries a specific and well-understood meaning for Hindu devotees where it denotes sacred food offered to and blessed by the deity at the Ram temple.“The commercial appropriation of this phrase for ordinary confectionery products, without any authorisation from the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, constitutes not just a misleading trade practice under Consumer Protection Act but an affront to religious sentiments of crores of consumers,” the order said.The order was issued following a complaint by Confederation of All India Traders (CAIT) in Jan 2024. The complaint alleged commercially manufactured sweets were being sold on Amazon under names suggesting that they were authentic prasad associated with the Ram temple in Ayodhya, without any authorisation, affiliation or endorsement from the temple or the trust.CCPA found four such products listed by Chandu Trading Company under Bihar Brothers brand.The products included ghee laddu, khoya laddu, ghee boondi laddu and desi cow milk peda, priced between Rs 299 and Rs 385. The listings used religious imagery and references to Lord Ram and Ayodhya, while claiming the products carried “Blessings from Shree Ram Janam Bhumi Temple, Ayodhya”. The ingredient description on the listings also referred to the contents as “Ram Mandir Prasad”.The authority said the listings were particularly concerning because they were live shortly before the consecration ceremony of the Ram temple, when religious sentiment and consumer interest were at their peak.Amazon removed the listings after receiving CCPA’s show-cause notice on Jan 19, 2024, and disclosed the identity of the third-party seller. The company argued it was only a marketplace intermediary and that the seller was responsible for listing, pricing and describing the products.CCPA, however, held that Amazon by hosting, displaying and facilitating sale of the listings was a party to the publication of misleading advertisements under Section 21(4) of Consumer Protection Act, 2019. The authority noted sales generated through the listings amounted to Rs 25.3 lakh, from which Amazon also earned commission or marketplace fees.Amazon informed CCPA that sales from the four disputed listings generated Rs 39,802 from which it received Rs 15,165 as a service fee. It said that the Rs 25.3 lakh figure disclosed earlier represented the seller’s gross merchandise sales across all its listings.
Article Summary: Ccpa fined amazon rs 1 lakh for allowing misleading ads selling ordinary sweets as 'shri ram mandir ayodhya prasad' there was no authorisation from shri ram janmabhoomi teerth kshetra trust for the laddu (sweets) sold as prasad.

Article Title: BEL, Ananth Technologies ink pact
Article Text:
The partnership will explore opportunities to develop systems and subsystems for missiles, radars, satellites and navigation system

BENGALURU: Ananth Technologies and Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) have signed an MoU to jointly develop and manufacture advanced electronic systems for defence and aerospace applications, in a move aimed at expanding indigenous capabilities in strategic technologies.The partnership will explore opportunities to develop systems and subsystems for missiles, radars, satellites and navigation systems, the companies said on Wednesday.Under the agreement, the two companies will work across the technology chain, including design and development, system engineering, electronics manufacturing, integration, testing and production.The collaboration brings together the complementary capabilities of the two companies. BEL, a Navratna public sector undertaking under the defence ministry, has extensive experience in developing and manufacturing electronic systems for the armed forces. Ananth Technologies, which has more than three decades of experience, works on aerospace and defence electronics, satellite systems, launch vehicle avionics, navigation technologies and advanced manufacturing.Ananth Technologies managing director Anurup Pavuluri said the partnership would focus on indigenous design and development as well as manufacturing and integration for current and future strategic programmes.The agreement comes as India seeks to expand domestic manufacturing of sophisticated defence and aerospace systems and reduce reliance on imported technologies. The companies said their collaboration would contribute to strengthening the country’s aerospace and defence industrial ecosystem.Ananth Technologies has capabilities spanning satellite systems, missile electronics, navigation systems, radio-frequency and seeker technologies, aerospace electronics manufacturing and system integration. It works with India’s space and defence establishments on strategic programmes.BEL manufactures electronic systems for the Army, Navy and Air Force and has also expanded into areas including space electronics, satellite integration, cyber security, railways and metro systems, and homeland security.
Article Summary: Ananth technologies and bharat electronics limited (bel) have signed an mou to jointly develop and manufacture advanced electronic systems. The partnership will explore opportunities to develop systems and subsystems for missiles, radars, satellites and navigation system.

Article Title: UP moving strongly towards $1 trillion economy; state has edge in infrastructure, logistics: CM Yogi Adityanath
Article Text:
UP moving strongly towards USD 1 trillion economy; state has edge in infrastructure, logistics: CM Yogi Adityanath (Photo: ANI)

NEW DELHI: Uttar Pradesh is moving strongly towards becoming a $1 trillion economy, chief minister Yogi Adityanath said on Wednesday, highlighting the state's advantages in infrastructure, logistics, industrial growth and good governance as key drivers of its economic expansion.Addressing UP-Japan Investment Meet 2026, CM Adityanath said that the state has continuously improved and stands amongst the country's top three economies."We are moving strongly towards becoming a one-trillion-dollar economy," the CM said, stressing, "Uttar Pradesh has the advantage of infrastructure, logistics, industrial growth, and good governance."Further highlighting the state's economic progress, Adityanath said, "In the past nine years, we have succeeded in tripling Uttar Pradesh's budget, GSDP, and per capita income. Women's workforce participation has also increased more than threefold."He also highlighted the state's expanding infrastructure, noting that "multimodal logistics and industrial corridors, electronics and semiconductor ecosystems, and data-centre infrastructure are continuously expanding."Adityanath said Uttar Pradesh accounts for 60 per cent of the country's total expressways and has 17 airports, India's largest railway network, metro networks, the country's first Rapid Rail, first inland waterway, two dedicated freight corridors and logistics hubs, providing global-standard connectivity.Union Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan emphasised leveraging Japanese technology and expertise to benefit Indian farmers at the UP-Japan Investment Meet 2026.Pitching Uttar Pradesh as a strong destination for Japanese investment, he said the India-Japan partnership should not be limited to investment, but should extend its benefits to farmers, youth and the rural economy.Adding to this, he noted, India's vast market, large young population and significant agricultural potential, combined with Japan's technological and industrial expertise, could open new opportunities in the agriculture sector.Chouhan urged Japanese industries and institutions to develop technologies and machinery that are useful and easily accessible to small and marginal farmers.He said the state has the potential to combine Japan's technological expertise with Uttar Pradesh's talent and market opportunities to create new avenues for employment, innovation and sustainable growth.However, Chouhan stressed there is a need for technologies that can increase farm productivity, reduce water consumption and production costs, and raise farmers' incomes. The Minister also called for greater participation of rural youth in the agriculture technology ecosystem.He emphasised that closer coordination between agriculture and manufacturing could help develop technologies suited to farmers' needs.The UP-Japan Investment Meet 2026 is being held from August 18 to 23 across Uttar Pradesh and Delhi, with more than 200 Japanese industrialists, CEOs, business representatives and policymakers.Further, bilateral trade between India and Japan stood at around $27.5 billion in 2025-26. Exports from Japan to India during this period were $21.43 billion and imports were $6.04 billion, with India ranking 14th in Japan's total trade with a 1.75 per cent share, as per government data.
Article Summary: Up moving strongly towards usd 1 trillion economy; state has edge in infrastructure, logistics: cm yogi adityanath. Article Title: Panel seeks 20% cap on drug, medical device mark-ups
Article Text:
A parliamentary panel said the gap between landing cost and MRP needs to be reduced to make medicines and medical devices more affordable. (Representative Image)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Insightful Agree Disagree Skeptical Concerning Promising Worth Reading Big Development Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

NEW DELHI: A parliamentary panel has recommended that the gap between the landing price, or the cost at which a medicine or medical device reaches the market, and its MRP should not exceed 20%, citing wide price disparities that can increase patients' out-of-pocket expenditure.The Standing Committee on Health and Family Welfare cited Tenecteplase, a life-saving clot-busting drug used during the golden hour of a heart attack, as an example. According to the report, its landing cost is Rs 18,000, while the MRP is Rs 50,000, with patients being billed at the MRP.The panel said the gap between landing cost and MRP needs to be reduced to make medicines and medical devices more affordable. It also recommended rationalising the prices of peripheral stents and drug-eluting balloons.Pointing to the impact of price regulation, the committee noted that cardiac stents, which earlier cost around Rs 1.9 lakh, were capped at Rs 25,000-30,000 in 2017.The panel, however, stressed that lowering prices should not compromise the quality or availability of medical devices. It recommended strict quality-management systems for manufacturers and called for measures to prevent shortages and black marketing while rationalising prices of high-end medical consumables.The committee also flagged the cost of clear aligners, ranging from Rs 1.5 lakh to Rs 5 lakh, and recommended that regulators consider standardising the prices of clear aligners and dental materials.It further recommended promoting domestic production of costly devices such as implantable cardioverter defibrillators, heart valves, cardiac cath labs, pacemakers and PET scanners, noting that some are not covered under Ayushman Bharat and add to patients’ out-of-pocket burden. It also proposed a dedicated medical-devices subsidy fund for R&D and scaling, along with incentives and preferential government procurement for devices with at least 50% domestic content, and expansion of MedTech parks and testing facilities
Article Summary: The standing committee on health and family welfare cited tenecteplase, a life-saving clot-busting drug used during the golden hour of a heart attack, as an example. The panel said the gap between landing cost and mrp needs to be reduced to make medicines more affordable.

Article Title: Valkyrae’s AI controversy grows as streamer reveals the artist behind her disputed YouTube thumbnail
Article Text:
Valkyrae addresses AI allegations over YouTube thumbnail

Valkyrae defends thumbnail artist Anko

Rachell “Valkyrae” Hofstetter has addressed a growing debate over the artwork used for her YouTube livestreams after viewers accused her latest thumbnail of being AI-generated. The streamer defended her longtime thumbnail artist, Anko, while admitting she understands why some people reached that conclusion. Her comments also highlight a wider concern for digital artists as AI-generated content continues to reshape how audiences view online artwork.The controversy began after Anko, Valkyrae’s thumbnail artist, shared the creative process behind artwork for her Uncharted playthrough. The thumbnail initially received attention from viewers, but some quickly questioned whether artificial intelligence had been used to create it.That reaction eventually reached Valkyrae, who explained that Anko creates all of her YouTube livestream thumbnails and regularly shares his process online. She also pointed out the irony of the situation, saying that even those behind-the-scenes videos have not stopped people from making AI accusations.Valkyrae said:"Okay. We have to talk about this thumbnail debacle. I don't know what to do about this thumbnail debacle.So, as most of you know, every single one of my YouTube livestream thumbnails is made by the same artist. His name is Anko, and he makes all of them. He even posts on Twitter the art process of making them, but it still never beats the AI allegations. And the most recent thumbnail, he makes new thumbnails when I start a new game series, so, obviously, there is a new thumbnail for the Uncharted era. And people were saying, 'Oh, it's AI slop,' in the pre-chat."The streamer then offered a more nuanced response. Rather than dismissing viewers who suspected AI, she said she understood where their reaction came from. At the same time, she wanted to make clear that the artwork was not created using AI.Valkyrae added:"'Just ignore them.' Well, no. Okay? I don't blame people for thinking it's AI because AI is using people's art, like Anko's, to take over. But I would like to clear it up because there were a few people that were saying, 'Oh! When I saw the thumb, I also thought it was AI.' So now I am wondering how many people are out there that would watch the stream, but didn't because of the AI-looking thumbnail! But it's not AI."The discussion also became personal for Valkyrae because she said she felt bad for Anko. The thumbnail was later updated, with the artist adding his signature, giving viewers another indication of who created the work.Valkyrae explained that the situation made her think about the broader impact AI tools could have on working artists. For creators who depend on commissioned digital artwork, being mistaken for AI-generated work can create a difficult problem. The visual style that once helped an artist stand out can now cause audiences to question whether a human created it at all.She said:"I don't know, dude. I don't know what to do about it. I feel bad for him, though, because... and then, it, like, reminded me. I was like, 'Man, I just shouldn't do art thumbnails.' But then, the whole AI thing is doing what it does - making artists lose their jobs! Isn't that crazy?!"The controversy has now become more than a discussion about one YouTube thumbnail. Valkyrae’s response reflects a growing tension between AI-generated imagery and human-made digital art, particularly on social media where polished artwork can be judged within seconds.For Valkyrae, however, the message is straightforward: the Uncharted thumbnail was made by Anko, not AI. The debate instead shows how difficult it has become for artists to prove the human work behind their creations.
Article Summary: Valkyrae addresses ai allegations over youtube thumbnail. The streamer defended her longtime thumbnail artist, anko. Her comments highlight a wider concern for digital artists as ai-generated content continues to reshape how audiences view online artwork.

Article Title: Quote of the day by Michael J. Fox: "I think the scariest person in the world is the person with…" - a lesson on humour, perspective and facing hard times with lightness
Article Text:
Quote of the day by Michael J. Fox (AP photo)

Quote of the day by Michael J. Fox

"I think the scariest person in the world is the person with no sense of humor"

Where this quote actually comes from

Why humour matters most during genuinely difficult stretches

How humour actually helps people manage stress

Why laughing at your own mistakes actually matters

Why humour can genuinely strengthen relationships

Michael J. Fox's own perspective on adversity

Why humour is not the same thing as avoiding a real problem

Why being naturally serious is not actually a flaw

Other memorable quotes by Michael J. Fox

"One's dignity may be assaulted, vandalized and cruelly mocked, but it can never be taken away unless it is surrendered."

"I am careful not to confuse excellence with perfection."

"Family is not an important thing. It's everything."

"Acceptance doesn't mean resignation; it means understanding that something is what it is and that there's got to be a way through it."

Why people still find meaning in this quote

Humour can genuinely change how a difficult moment actually feels. A stressful situation seems lighter once someone finds a reason to laugh, and a serious problem often becomes easier to approach once it can be seen from another angle. It can create a little distance from fear, frustration and uncertainty, even when the circumstances themselves have not changed. Michael J. Fox , the actor and Parkinson's disease advocate, put a striking twist on that idea. "I think the scariest person in the world is the person with no sense of humor," he said. Not being able to laugh, in his framing, is not simply a personality quirk. It genuinely limits how someone can respond to life, and coming from someone who has lived with a serious, lifelong illness for decades, the line carries a good deal more weight than a passing joke.This line comes from an interview Fox gave to journalist Amy Wallace, published on Reader's Digest's website. Fox is not really suggesting that a humourless person is dangerous in any literal sense. He is pointing at the seriousness that tends to surround someone who cannot laugh at themselves, cannot recognise irony, and cannot find any lightness in a genuinely difficult moment. Humour creates real distance from a problem.It lets someone acknowledge that something is hard without letting it completely take over.Life inevitably brings disappointment, uncertainty and real stress. Humour cannot solve every problem on its own, but it can genuinely change how someone responds to one. Being able to laugh during a hard period offers a small emotional break, and it can help people communicate when a direct, serious conversation feels too uncomfortable to actually have. None of this means every situation deserves to be treated as a joke. Humour and genuine seriousness can exist side by side.Stress tends to narrow someone's attention down entirely onto the immediate problem in front of them. A moment of real laughter can interrupt that cycle. Research into humour and stress has suggested that positive humour can genuinely influence mood and help people cope with stressful experiences, and laughter itself is linked to physiological changes, including a release of muscle tension. None of this should be overstated. Humour is never a substitute for professional help or a practical solution when someone faces a genuinely serious problem. As an everyday coping tool, though, it can offer a genuinely useful shift in perspective.One of the most valuable forms of humour is simply being able to laugh at your own missteps. Nobody gets everything right. People mispronounce words, misjudge situations and occasionally embarrass themselves, and someone who can acknowledge a mistake without being consumed by embarrassment tends to find it easier to actually learn from it. Self-directed humour also tends to make social interactions considerably more comfortable, since it signals that a person does not expect flawless perfection from either themselves or anyone else around them.Shared laughter helps people form real connections. Friends, colleagues and family members often use humour to build a sense of familiarity and trust, and a well-placed joke can break tension that a serious conversation might struggle to shift on its own. There is an important line here worth being clear about, between humour that actually brings people together and humour that humiliates someone else. Jokes built on cruelty or prejudice tend to damage relationships rather than genuinely strengthen them, and the most constructive kind of humour has never really needed anyone else to get hurt.Fox became one of the most recognisable actors of his generation through films and television, including Back to the Future and Family Ties. In 1991, at the age of 29, he was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease. He later made the diagnosis public and became a prominent advocate for Parkinson's research through the Michael J. Fox Foundation. His public approach to living with the condition has consistently included honesty, genuine optimism and humour, which gives his comments about laughter an extra dimension. His point was never that difficult experiences are inherently funny. It is that holding onto a sense of humour can help someone preserve real perspective while actually facing a genuine challenge. His decades-long relationship with humour, cultivated alongside a chronic illness he never chose, reveals that laughter was never a denial of hardship for Fox, but a deliberate, hard-won tool for maintaining perspective and genuine hope through real adversity.There is a meaningful difference between using humour to cope with something difficult and using it to avoid actually dealing with it at all. Some problems genuinely require serious attention and real action, and nobody can simply laugh away financial difficulty, illness or grief. What humour can offer instead is a small amount of emotional breathing space while someone continues addressing the actual underlying issue, which is really the whole distinction worth holding onto here.Fox's quote is deliberately provocative, and it should not be read as suggesting that serious people are inherently unpleasant. Some people naturally have quieter personalities, or simply express humour in a different way. The broader lesson is really about flexibility rather than personality type. Someone who can be genuinely serious when it matters, while still finding moments of humour elsewhere, tends to have more ways of responding to life's challenges than someone who treats every single situation with exactly the same level of weight.Humour is easy to underrate, since it can look insignificant next to more obviously serious qualities like intelligence or discipline. Even so, the ability to laugh genuinely shapes how people communicate, handle their own mistakes and respond to real difficulty. Fox's quote offers a deliberately provocative reminder that life does not always need to be approached with complete seriousness. There will be moments when humour is genuinely inappropriate, and problems that cannot be laughed away at all. In between those moments, though, holding onto a sense of humour tends to keep people connected, flexible and hopeful, which is really the whole point behind the line.
Article Summary: "i think the scariest person in the world is the person with no sense of humor" michael j. Fox, actor and parkinson's disease advocate. Not being able to laugh is not simply a personality quirk. It genuinely limits how someone can respond to life. Michael j. Fox was one of the most recognisable actors of his generation.

Article Title: Former Google CEO Eric Schmidt is 'in the market' looking for a billionaire and the reason is this listing
Article Text:
What makes Whisper's sale 'interesting'

Inside Whisper: 12-meter mosaic pool, private cinema, nightclub and basketball court

Eric Schmidt, the former Google CEO is looking for a new billionaire owner for his superyacht, Whisper. According to a report in Boat International, one of the world’s most recognizable superyachts has officially returned to the market for sale. Whisper, the 95.2-meter (312-foot) German-built Lurssen, has been listed for sale with Will Christie of Christie Yachts with an asking price of 149 million Euros (approximately $170 million). As per the report, the listing follows a comprehensive interior refit completed in 2025 by Michael Smith Design. Whisper will be at anchor during the 2026 Monaco Yacht Show and available for inspections in the South of France on September 1 and 2.Delivered by Lurssen in 2014 under her original name, Kismet, the 2,928 GT vessel was commissioned by billionaire sports team owner Shahid Khan to replace his earlier 68-meter superyacht, Atlas. Built around a lavish "caviar and champagne" concept, she features exterior lines and a striking jet-black mast—paired with opulent, Art Deco-inspired interior spaces conceived by Reymond Langton Design. The vessel earned a World Superyacht Award in 2015, with judges lauding her construction quality, exterior profile, and expansive deck layouts.Schmidt reportedly acquired the yacht from Khan in September 2023 and renamed her Whisper. In late 2023, ahead of the delivery of Khan's 122-meter replacement vessel, the yacht spent just three months on the market before being acquired by former Google CEO Eric Schmidt, who renamed her Whisper.Speaking exclusively to BOAT International, Whisper's listing broker, Will Christie, said, "Given the lack of boats for sale at the moment that are over 80 metres from northern European shipyards, I think this will be quite interesting to people. With the increase in new-build costs, if you were to build a comparable yacht today, I wouldn’t be surprised if you were getting too far off €400 million and waiting four, maybe five years - so she is an interesting opportunity given the current market conditions and construction costs. "Christie noted that she is the ideal yacht for entertaining, with multiple social areas across all five of her decks. Similarly, she is great for families of all ages, which Christie explained makes her "pretty flexible" when it comes to her next owner. Christie told BOAT that the interior refit aimed to make her interiors "more contemporary and light," particularly on the bridge deck, which has been transformed from a sports bar deck to a "beautiful Riva-inspired saloon. " Her new interiors are decorated in a mixture of dark wood panelling and light leathers with modern features and marbled areas throughout.Conceived as an extravagant venue for world-class entertaining, the vessel opens into a main saloon marked by intricate carving and marble flooring. An atrium staircase connects the main level to the owner’s deck, framed by customizable, full-height digital video walls. At the foot of the stairs sits an integrated fireplace alongside a bespoke self-playing piano.The main deck also houses a full-beam cinema equipped with a 4K projection system and motorized blackout curtains, allowing the space to function seamlessly as an auxiliary saloon. Outdoor entertainment spaces on the main deck aft include an integrated firepit lounge and an al fresco dining setting configured for 10 guests.Accommodation across the vessel is configured for up to 16 guests across seven en-suite staterooms and a convertible office. The master suite features dedicated private offices, separate dressing rooms, and a central his-and-hers en suite divided by concealed pocket doors, complete with dual rain showers. The master stateroom opens directly onto a private exterior deck fitted with a mosaic-tiled spa pool and provides direct access to the yacht’s certified helipad, which is engineered to convert into an outdoor basketball court, dance floor, or open sun lounge. Additional guest quarters include two VIP suites, two standard double cabins, and three convertible staterooms.

Article Title: Monarch butterfly has been added to endangered species list, to conserve them scientists in California have given them solar-powered radio backpacks
Article Text:
Representative Image. Credit: PBS

"radio backpacks."

Solar-powered radio tags track monarch butterfly movement

“The goal of this project is to increase our understanding of monarch butterfly use of overwintering groves in coastal California. The results will be used to better inform restoration and management of monarch overwintering groves,”

How scientists attach radio backpacks to monarch butterflies

Monarch butterfly conservation gets help from citizen scientists

Scientists are using tiny solar-powered devices to track the movements of endangered monarch butterflies. Researchers on the California coast are using these devices to understand how the butterflies use their overwintering habitats and nearby nectar sources. The migratory monarch butterfly (Danaus plexippus plexippus) was listed as Endangered on the IUCN Red List in 2022, while the US Fish & Wildlife Service has separately proposed listing monarchs as threatened under the Endangered Species Act.The tracking project uses small radio telemetry devices attached to the butterflies' backs, effectively giving them what can be described as solar-poweredAccording to the US Fish & Wildlife Service (USFWS), the technology is being tested to collect movement data and understand how monarchs use overwintering groves and nearby nectar flowers in California.The USFWS Coastal Program in Central California partnered with Althouse & Meade, a biological and environmental consulting firm, to test the tracking technology. In November 2025, staff and partners tagged monarchs at three overwintering sites across San Luis Obispo and Santa Barbara Counties.The devices use solar-powered radio telemetry to transmit geospatial information through radio waves. Each tag is small enough to be attached to a monarch's back, allowing researchers to follow its movements without relying solely on visual observations. Weather information is also being collected at the sites so researchers can compare environmental conditions with the butterflies' movements.the US Fish & Wildlife Service said in a statementCatching the butterflies requires taking advantage of their dependence on external heat. Monarchs are ectotherms, meaning they rely on the environment to regulate their body temperature. They need warmth from the sun to reach the body temperature required for flight.For that reason, collection and tagging began early in the morning, when temperatures were below 55 degrees Fahrenheit, and the butterflies were less able to fly. After being collected, the monarchs were kept in a cooler at or below 55 degrees Fahrenheit.Researchers identified each butterfly as male or female and recorded its weight and measurements before deciding whether it was large enough to carry a telemetry tag. The small transmitters were then attached to the butterflies' backs using eyelash glue, according to the USFWS.The California tracking project also allows members of the public to contribute observations. The USFWS said people can use the Project Monarch app to access a map showing tagged monarchs and enter their own data.The information collected through the project is intended to help researchers understand how monarchs use coastal California's overwintering habitat and nearby nectar sources. The findings could then inform restoration and management of overwintering groves.The IUCN added the migratory monarch butterfly to its Endangered category in 2022 after assessing the population's decline and threats. The classification applies specifically to the migratory monarch population, rather than every monarch butterfly population worldwide.Researchers also hope the long-term dataset will reveal how shifting climate patterns influence migration timing and survival rates, enabling predictive models that support habitat connectivity planning along the Pacific flyway corridor.
Article Summary: The tracking project uses small radio telemetry devices attached to the butterflies' backs, effectively giving them what can be described as solar-powered. Researchers on the california coast are using these devices to understand how the butterflies use their overwintering habitats and nearby nectar sources.

Article Title: GTA 6 leak: gameplay clips and the full Leonida map hit the internet days before the Netflix reveal
Article Text:
Image via Rockstar Games

Leaked GTA 6 gameplay shows a Focus stat, a stamina meter and the six-star wanted level

The leaked GTA 6 map splits Leonida into five counties, including one nobody has seen

GTA 6 release date holds at November 19, Netflix Extended Look lands August 27

Two clips that appear to show Grand Theft Auto 6 gameplay leaked online on August 18, along with an image of the game's full map. Rockstar Games has spent the hours since trying to scrub them off social media. Neither the publisher nor parent company Take-Two has confirmed the footage is real, but the DMCA takedown notices going out to everyone reposting it have answered that question fairly well on their own.The material is watermarked with links to a group calling itself CyberLeek, which says it leaked the game to protest the industry's slide towards digital-only ownership. Its complaints cover digital pre-orders, single-player DLC it calls fake, and publishers switching off games people already paid for. GTA 6 shipping its physical edition as a code in a box rather than a disc looks like the trigger. The group ended its manifesto by telling publishers to "behave, or be the next target. "The first clip is the quiet one. Jason steps off the balcony of the waterfront house from the second trailer, walks past a jetski, and shoots hoops in the driveway. Scoring works on a timing system where you press a button as two rings overlap, and a made shot bumps a Focus stat by two per cent.That is Red Dead Redemption 2 territory, and it suggests mini-games feed straight into character traits.The second clip has the detail. Jason clips a Scoop delivery truck on the highway, the driver climbs out swinging, and a stamina bar drains through the fight. Jason takes the man's wrench and beats him to death with it, emptying the bar and vignetting the edges of the screen. A devil icon with a minus sign follows, and it only appears once the driver is already down, which points to a karma system that judges you for the finishing blows rather than the brawl itself.Two wanted stars light up next, with four unlit stars beside them, so the six-star ceiling is back after sitting out GTA 5. Icons below track what the police know about you: your clothing, your face, your car. Back at the vehicle, prompts for Loadout and Storage 0/4 appear, followed by the car's name, a fuel gauge and an engine meter.The map is a squashed, redrawn south Florida. Vice City sits on the east coast, green space fills the west and north, and a chain of islands runs south where the Keys should be. Five counties are labelled: Lummox, Leonard, Kelly, Vice Dale and Mariana. Lummox has not appeared in any GTA 6 material before now.Jason's house is marked on one of the southern islands, small race tracks are scattered across the state, and a second airport sits at the end of the island chain. The map also shows a car icon marked J while the player arrow floats over water, meaning you can see where the other protagonist is without switching to them. GTA 5 never allowed that.Some caution is warranted. Nobody knows how old the build is, and the clips were captured with HDR on, so they look washed out on a standard screen. Rockstar confirmed in April that company information was accessed in a third-party breach, though it said players were unaffected.This is the third time GTA 6 has shown up early, after more than 90 development videos leaked in 2022 and the debut trailer surfaced a day ahead of schedule in December 2023. Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look premieres on Netflix on August 27 at 12pm PT, and moves to YouTube six hours later. The game launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19.
